Paper: control light K0R0, KD heavy K8R10. FL0067_AysegulS_2 MGF precursor pairs show strong K8 (+8.0142) and R10 (+10.0083) partners (1508/769 vs ~280 background) and none at K4/R6 -> L/H mix = KD set
Paper: Fusion Lumos used for SILAC samples; FL0067_AysegulS_2 is the only FL file with a pure light/heavy (K8R10) pattern
RAW header 'Orbitrap Fusion Lumos'

limitations: Precursor/fragment tolerances not annotated: Mascot searches used differing precursor tolerances (0.05 or 0.1 Da) and the MaxQuant parameters used for quantification were not deposited.
characteristics[treatment] values are free text (no NCIT/EFO term for a gene-specific or non-targeting siRNA); validator warns.

BLOCKED: FL0067_AysegulS_3.raw (the second SILAC run, expected per paper to be HeLa vector (light) vs USP32-HA overexpression (medium K4R6)) is not annotated. Its MGF shows light-medium (K4/R6), light-heavy (K8/R10) AND medium-heavy (+3.989) precursor pairs well above background, i.e. a three-channel mix the paper does not describe; the identity of its heavy channel (and hence a full channel map) is not in any public source.
SILAC label-specific modifications (Label:13C(6)15N(2) K, Label:13C(6)15N(4) R) are conveyed only through comment[label]; the MaxQuant SILAC configuration was not deposited.
Di-Gly (K-epsilon-GG) antibody enrichment of all samples (paper Methods, PRIDE protocol) is not encoded: no PRIDE/EFO child of EFO:0009090 for ubiquitin-remnant peptide enrichment was found in OLS.
